Container.Name: osu-tourney-hub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted website for an osu! tournament team: osu! login, wybin import, mappool sheets with scores, lineups, availability, match lobby skimmer and matchup predictions. Needs an osu! OAuth application and an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent application data (the database). Include it in your appdata backup.

Config.Name: osu! client ID
Config.Description: Client ID of your osu! OAuth application.

Config.Name: osu! client secret
Config.Description: Client secret of your osu! OAuth application.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public https address of this site without a path, for example https://tourney.example.com. The OAuth callback URL is this address plus /auth/callback.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: At least 32 random characters. Keep it secret; changing it logs everyone out.

Config.Name: Admin osu! IDs
Config.Description: osu! user ids of the administrators, comma-separated.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container writes files as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container writes files as.

Config.Name: osu! API requests per minute
Config.Description: Overall osu! API request budget per minute. The osu! guidance is at most 60.

Config.Name: wybin poll minutes
Config.Description: Minutes between wybin syncs of active tournaments (minimum 10).

Config.Name: wybin request interval seconds
Config.Description: Seconds to wait between two requests to wybin (1 to 60). Keep it polite.

Config.Name: Scanner enabled
Config.Description: Scan new osu! multiplayer lobbies for maps of the current mappools.

Config.Name: Scanner budget per minute
Config.Description: osu! requests per minute the scanner may use. Must be lower than the overall request budget.

Config.Name: Scanner workers
Config.Description: Parallel scanner tasks (1 to 8). They share the scanner budget.

Config.Name: Scanner max backlog
Config.Description: Lobby ids the scanner may fall behind before it skips ahead.

Config.Name: Scanner open lobby hours
Config.Description: Hours after which a still-open lobby is finalised.

Config.Name: Score refresh hours
Config.Description: Hours before a player's score on a map is fetched again.

Config.Name: Live poll seconds
Config.Description: Seconds between polls during live match mode (minimum 5).

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warning, error or critical.

Config.Name: AI provider
Config.Description: Provider for optional AI predictions. Empty keeps them off.

Config.Name: AI API key
Config.Description: API key of the AI provider (not needed for a local endpoint).

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Model name to use. Required when an AI provider is set.

Config.Name: AI base URL
Config.Description: Only for an OpenAI-compatible or local endpoint.
